qa.question: If an opponent activates a Quick ability in response to this follower's attack, will this follower's Strike ability resolve first?

qa.title: Q932 (Oct. 8, 2024)
qa.question: If this follower's defense is reduced to 0 by damage, will its ability still trigger?
qa.answer: Yes, it will, provided that the damage that reduces its defense to 0 is greater than 5.

qa.title: Q931 (Oct. 8, 2024)
qa.question: If I have more than 10 cards in my cemetery, and an opponent deals 3 damage and 2 more damage to this follower on my field with Usurping Spineblade, will my max play points increase by 1?
qa.answer: No, it won't. Even though Usurping Spineblade does a total of 5 damage, it does so in two instances of damage, and this follower's ability only applies to a single instance of damage.

qa.title: Q951 (Oct. 8, 2024)
qa.question: If I have multiple cards with an "At the start of your end phase" ability triggering, in what order do I resolve them?
qa.answer: You can resolve them in any order. When you proceed to your end phase, all "At the start of your end phase" abilities are triggered and become pending. Then, you can choose the order in which you resolve the pending abilities.

qa.title: Q950 (Oct. 8, 2024)
qa.question: If I have multiple copies of this follower on the field while my leader's defense is 5, will each copy's end phase ability be able to take effect?
qa.answer: No, they won't. Although each copy's end phase ability will be able to trigger, the effect of the first copy's ability will change your leader's defense to 10, preventing each subsequent copy's ability from taking effect. Therefore, your leader will only gain 5 defense, and you will only be able to draw 1 card.

qa.title: Q949 (Oct. 8, 2024)
qa.question: If I have this follower and Lucifer on my field while my leader's defense is 5, will both followers' end phase abilities be able to take effect?
qa.answer: Yes, they will. However, although this follower's ability will trigger at the start of your end phase, its effect is based on your leader's defense when the ability resolves. Therefore, in order for both abilities to take effect, you must resolve this follower's ability before resolving Lucifer's ability.

qa.title: Q953 (Oct. 8, 2024)
qa.question: Can I banish 3 cards that each have the Cute, Cool, and Passion traits, such as New Wave, as part of this card's additional cost to play it for 9 less play points?
qa.answer: No. A card with all three traits will only count as one card. It may be counted towards any of the trait cards, but you will still need to banish a total of nine cards, three from each trait, to pay the additional cost.
